subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should #99912 wait for a maintainer-run current-main Docker reproduction before queueing a fix, or is the reporter's v2026.6.11 evidence enough to start repair now?
rationale: The reporter's evidence is concrete and recent, but current main already carries the obvious explicit-agent path and the likely remaining failure could be scheduled wake, manual wake, global session scope, or config shape.

options.title: Require current-main live reproduction
options.body: Reproduce the Docker multi-agent setup on current main before queueing a fix so the repair targets the real dropped-agent path.

options.title: Queue repair from reporter evidence
options.body: Start a fix job using the reporter's v2026.6.11 evidence, accepting a higher chance of duplicating or fighting existing routing code.

recommendation.title: Require current-main live reproduction
recommendation.body: Reproduce the Docker multi-agent setup on current main before queueing a fix so the repair targets the real dropped-agent path.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the most relevant merged multi-agent heartbeat work and can best judge whether the remaining failure belongs in heartbeat scheduling, session scope, or gateway wake routing.
